extracted.name: Tartar Sauce Recipe
extracted.description: This homemade tartar sauce recipe is so much better than store-bought! Creamy, tangy, and fresh, it's easy to make with simple ingredients. See the blog post above for my favorite ways to serve it.
instruction_lines: In a medium bowl, stir together the mayo, pickles, capers, dill, lemon juice, sugar, mustard, garlic, onion powder, and several grinds of pepper. Season to taste.
